title: GAP Waiver Plus 150 Exclusions: Deferred Installment Amount and the Rate Cap
content:
**GAP Waiver Addenda, GAP Waiver Plus 150 excluded total.** The installment amount the deferral part uses follows the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act rate cap in effect on the effective date of the latest extension the Retail Installment Contracts contract records. The latest cap-applied record, the latest cap-ended record and the latest extension are each the record of its kind with the latest effective date. Where two records of one kind share that date, the one recorded first counts.

1. **Cap in effect on the extension's date.** When a cap had taken effect on or before that date and had not ended by it, the amount is the installment the cap set.
2. **Extension before a running cap.** When that extension took effect before a cap that has not ended, the amount is the level installment of the signed terms: the amount financed times the monthly rate (the original annual percentage rate divided by 1,200), divided by one less the monthly rate plus one raised to the power of minus the original term in months, rounded half-up to the cent.
3. **Any other case.** The rate cap does not change the installment amount.

*Point of judgement.* A cap that ended on the very date the latest extension took effect had ended by it, so the first tier does not apply.
